ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.2/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.2/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.2/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.2: use the Bible translation your church is licensed for
- **Import a Bible file** in Settings → Bible. If your church holds a licence for a copyrighted translation (NRSV, NIV, NKJV, ESV…) and has its text as a file, ChurchStream can now use it for readings, responsive readings and the bulletin.
- Reads **JSON** files and **Zefania, OSIS and USFX XML**, the formats most Bible software and publishers export. Footnotes and cross-references are left out.
- The name and short name (e.g. *NRSV*) are filled in from the file. You tick **"Our church is licensed to use this translation"** before importing.
- The whole Bible, or at least the whole New Testament, is needed. Importing again replaces the earlier copy; **Remove** deletes it.
- The imported text stays **on that computer only**. ChurchStream never includes or downloads copyrighted Bibles, and saved services carry only the reading references.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
